stories.title: The Game Awards unveils its 2026 nominees, including CDawgVA for creator of the year
paragraphs: The Game Awards announced its 2026 nominees on November 17. Reporting lists 31 categories, with Grand Theft Auto VI leading the field with eight nominations.

The program also recognizes creators: CDawgVA was nominated for Content Creator of the Year. Public voting is open ahead of the December 10 ceremony, giving games and creator communities a shared awards conversation.

scoreNotes.general: The nominations set the agenda for a major year-end games event and include a visible creator category.
scoreNotes.heat: The awards span 31 categories, while discussion surfaced across games and creator communities; GTA VI led coverage with eight nominations.
scoreNotes.time: The nominee announcement was reported on November 17, inside this collection window.
scoreNotes.ethos: Multiple reports list the nominees, and a creator-community post corroborates CDawgVA's nomination.

stories.title: Studio Bravarda closes after its latest game failed to recover development costs
paragraphs: Lisbon-based Studio Bravarda announced it was closing after failing to recoup development costs for Extremely Powerful Capybaras, according to saved reports dated November 17.

The case shows how releasing a game does not guarantee a small developer can recover its investment. The available reports do not specify how many people were affected or what happens to the studio's other work.

scoreNotes.general: A small studio's closure is a concrete signal of the financial pressure facing indie development.
scoreNotes.heat: The closure affects the team behind a released indie game, though the saved coverage does not establish the number of jobs affected.
scoreNotes.time: Infobae dated its report November 17; no more precise time was available.
scoreNotes.ethos: Two reports identify the closure and say the studio did not recoup the latest game's costs; staffing and next steps remain unclear.
